description: OpenRocket golden reference: 'A simple model rocket' example on Estes C6-5

provenance.export: data/reference/openrocket-alpha3-c6.csv (File > Export simulation table as CSV)
provenance.note: OpenRocket's bundled 'A simple model rocket' example, NOT the Estes Alpha III kit. Same 25 mm diameter and C6 motor class; heavier structure.

chute.derivation: post-deploy drag coefficient 115.2 on 4.909 cm2 reference area = cdA 0.0566 m2 = 30 cm chute at Cd 0.8

known_model_differences: OpenRocket flies 3D with 2 m/s wind and angle-of-attack drag; Ascent v0.1 is vertical point-mass with zero wind
OpenRocket Cd is Mach/Reynolds-dependent (0.87 static -> 0.63 coast); Ascent uses one constant Cd
OpenRocket deploys the chute at ejection charge (burnout + 5 s = 6.861 s, before apogee); Ascent deploys exactly at apogee
OpenRocket motor mass 23.1 g vs ThrustCurve NAR cert 24.1 g; matched by holding total liftoff mass equal (burnout mass identical: 60.459 g)
OpenRocket gravity is latitude-adjusted (9.792); Ascent default 9.80665 overridden to match
